blocks.value: Resistance is a price level where sellers usually become active, making it difficult for the stock to move higher.
Imagine This: Throw a ball towards the ceiling. The ceiling stops it from moving higher. Resistance acts like the ceiling for stock prices.
When prices reach resistance, many investors decide to sell, increasing supply.
If a stock repeatedly reaches ₹800 before falling again, ₹800 may be acting as a resistance level.
Like support, resistance is also an area rather than a single exact number.
